head_fixed_setting_failure.error_summary: Frozen Qwen3-VL processor image-token count mismatch caused by truncation='max_length' at the next ordered B1 row.

head_repair.image_token_handling: Disable truncation for B1 sealed-cohort head rows so image placeholders and expanded image tokens cannot be severed.
head_repair.text_only_excess_handling: Retain text tokens without truncation; 1536 remains the minimum padded length, and longer B1 inputs expand to their natural encoded length. Inputs beyond the model context fail fast without substitution.

prefix_identity_gate.comparison: For every row, canonicalize and hash the complete stored JSON object; compare row identity and every stored decision field without printing raw content.
prefix_identity_gate.execution: Regenerate action rows 1..227 and correctness rows 1..221 from the repaired code on separate GPUs.
prefix_identity_gate.failure_rule: Any row mismatch immediately records STOPPED_UNOPENED and discards the repair; no head continuation is permitted.
